scientific_integrity: All numerical examples are diagnostics; the infinity-time limits rely on the included analytic proof. Closely related 2025 treatment-resistance source full text was not accessible for direct comparison.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic density-independent irreducible Metzler stage system; fixed identical periodic pulse, Hardy–Weinberg genotype frequencies, strictly positive heterozygote survival, no genotype-dependent between-pulse fitness cost, at least one selected stage and both alleles present initially. Provides asymptotic postpulse rates without finite-time uniform errors, stochastic fixation or independently established historical priority.
title: Sharp fixation-rate dichotomy for stage-structured populations under periodic selection pulses
